Back and rear oblique: the head dome is a smooth disc bounded by two straight vertical cut lines through the fan, the wings carry knobs and a peg fringe on the lower edge, and the inner lower fan edge drops beside the h~
All views: a lumpy, beaded head on a completely smooth bare body with no cheek, chest or limb masses; under the fur ruling this mostly follows from smoothing the fan to the body's level.
Front: near-round white eye discs with small pupils dead centre give a stare; the sheet has tall ovals with a heavier upper lid and a large iris glancing to one side.

Front: the crown sits level with the fan top and carries a row of small knobs instead of rising between the ear roots, and the lower face is broad with cheek bulges at the mouth line instead of tapering to a small round~

Front and back: square shoulders with deltoid caps over a pinched waist read as an athletic hourglass, and from behind the upper back is a disc framed by dark notches at the shoulder corners (posed trunk IoU .853).

Side: the top of the upper arm is a pale flat-topped cap with a hard upper edge so the shoulder juts as a box, and a cuff band rings the wrist; these are the two R07 items Nick left open (paw kept by his ruling).
Front and side: four near-equal toe lobes in a straight row with straight cone claws on the toe fronts, and a vertical heel face with no domed instep (posed foot band IoU .642).
Front: the knee is a lit band over an inner crease instead of a soft kneecap plane, and the posed thigh and shin bands miss the sheet (IoU .828 and .644).
